run_GTestBreakOnFailureUnitTest: run the googletest break-on-failure unit test suite to verify seg-fault behavior on assertion failures
run_Run: run a subprocess command and return 1 if killed by a signal or 0 otherwise
test_RunAndVerify: test the RunAndVerify method to check if a program seg-faults given env var and flag values
test_testFlagOverridesEnvVar: test that the gtest_break_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable
test_testBreakOnFailureOverridesThrowOnF: test that gtest_break_on_failure overrides gtest_throw_on_failure when both are enabled
